concept: JACCL TCPAllGather side channel as peer-liveness channel
summary: In stock MLX main the side channel is used for bootstrap all-gathers and a barrier in the ring constructor; the RDMA completion wait loops never read it

facts.text: In stock MLX main the side channel is used for bootstrap all-gathers and a barrier in the ring constructor; the RDMA completion wait loops never read it
`RingGroup::initialize` exchanges left and right connection info with two side-channel all-gathers, which its comment says also act as a barrier before RTR and RTS
`RingGroup::barrier` is an `all_sum` of one `uint8_t` over RDMA, not a TCP barrier
`Config::get_side_channel` keeps the `TCPAllGather` alive in a lambda capture for the group's lifetime, so the socket stays open after init
A user-supplied factory or all-gather function replaces the TCP channel entirely, so there is no socket to watch for liveness
